full_judgment: 5. The trial court, by the judgment and decree dated 27.10.1996, dismissed the suit. The plaintiffs then preferred Other Class Appeal No. 6 of 1997 and after hearing the learned Subordinate Judge (now joint District Judge), First Court, Joypurhat allowed that appeal by the judgment and decree dated 29.10.1997. The contesting defendants then moved the High Court Division and obtained rule in Civil Revision No. 4397 of 1997 which was ultimately discharged after hearing by the judgment and order dated 17.07.2001. The defendants then preferred civil petition for leave to appeal against that judgment and order of the High Court Division and obtained leave on 08.04.2003 and consequently the above mentioned Civil Appeal No. 149 of 2003 was registered. Ultimately, this Division, after hearing the learned advocates for both the parties, dismissed that appeal by the judgment and order sought to be reviewed holding that there was no illegality or infirmity in the findings and decision of the High Court Division discharging the rule in Civil Revision No. 4397 of 1997. It should be mentioned here that in the judgment of this Division delivered on 20.02.2007 though there was clear finding that there was no illegality or infirmity in the findings and decision of the High Court Division and as such it did not call any interference but through mistake in the last line of this judgment it was written as "the appeal is allowed with cost at all stages." But subsequently upon an application filed by the respondents this mistake was corrected and it was recorded that the appeal was dismissed.
